title: Colts rule out CB Justin Walley, LB Akeem Davis-Gaither

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Colts rule out CB Justin Walley, LB Akeem Davis-Gaither
sources.description: The Colts ruled out cornerback Justin Walley (knee) and linebacker Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee) ahead of Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
